text:
I completely understand your frustration—this is stressful, and I'm sorry you're dealing with it.

Since tracking hasn't moved for a week and this is your third contact, I'm escalating you to a Support Lead immediately. They have full authority to investigate and resolve this quickly. A courier investigation will be opened (typically resolved within **5 business days**), and you'll be able to choose either a free replacement or full refund once we confirm the parcel is lost.

A Support Lead will reach out to you shortly. In the meantime, if you have your order number handy, that'll speed things up.
